title: No sea level equation
description: The simplest case: a Heaviside spherical cap at the pole, no ocean, no sea level equation. It coincides with Spada et al. (2011) test 1/2 for the cap load, and it establishes the level of disagreement between the codes before any ocean is added.

source.citation: Martinec, Z. et al. (2018). Geophysical Journal International 215(1), 389-414.

$outputs_comment: U is surface vertical displacement, N is geoid displacement, S is sea-surface variation. The paper compares these along latitudinal cross-sections, plus the thickness of the uniform water layer h_UF(t) where the sea level equation is solved.

comparison.interval: colatitude 0 to 20 degrees for the ice-centre cross-section

reference_data.reference: Z_ZM_load.out holds one row, so the VEGA reference must be reconstructed. See correction benchmarkA-vega-truncated.
